aboutGame.title: What is Free ChinaSide Tycoon?
paragraphs: Free ChinaSide Tycoon is a Roblox shipping business tycoon from Goyboy Games. You run a shipping agent operation, take customer orders, pack and photograph products, hire workers, expand your factory, and grow a warehouse empire one haul at a time.

Progress is built on Star Rating, Followers, Customers, Cash, and Offline Earnings. Manage police raids with Security staff, open Crates for rewards, and keep production moving so your business keeps earning even while you are away.

faq.title: Free ChinaSide Tycoon FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Free ChinaSide Tycoon on Roblox.

items.question: What is Free ChinaSide Tycoon?
items.answer: Free ChinaSide Tycoon is a Roblox business tycoon from Goyboy Games. You run a shipping agent operation, process customer orders, hire workers, expand your factory, handle police raids, open Crates, and earn Offline Earnings while you are away.

items.question: How do I start in Free ChinaSide Tycoon?
items.answer: Finish the tutorial, take your first shipping orders, and reinvest every payout into the cheapest output upgrade. Hire your first worker early so the business keeps earning between sessions.

items.question: Are there Free ChinaSide Tycoon codes?
items.answer: Yes. Redeem working codes in the in-game codes menu for Cash, Crates, and temporary Boosts. Codes can expire after an update, so redeem them as soon as you find them.

items.question: Which workers should I hire first in Free ChinaSide Tycoon?
items.answer: Hire the role that fixes your current bottleneck. Packers and Photographers keep orders moving, Forklift Drivers move stock, and Security staff reduce the cost of police raids.

items.question: How do I earn Cash faster in Free ChinaSide Tycoon?
items.answer: Balance factory production with order demand, stack production and worker upgrades, and set up idle collection before logging off so Offline Earnings fund your next purchase.
